words.engDef: to breathe out

words.chinese: 呼出（氣息）；將氣從肺部排出

words.engDef: to make something clear to someone
words.example: Could you explain to me why the project is behind schedule?
words.chinese: 向…解釋；向…說明（原因、理由或過程）

words.engDef: makes something clear so others understand it
words.example: The consultant explains the new policy to the team members.
words.chinese: 解釋；闡述；說明
words.rootPrefix: ex- (out) + planus (flat) -> to make it flat and plain

words.engDef: a statement that makes something clear
words.example: Could you provide an explanation for the delay in the project?
words.chinese: 解釋；說明（尤指對某事物的理由或過程）

words.engDef: giving reasons that make something clear
words.example: The report included an explanatory note on the financial figures.
words.chinese: 解釋性的，說明性的

words.engDef: clearly and directly, leaving no doubt
words.example: The company's policy explicitly states that employees cannot accept gifts from clients.
words.chinese: 明確地；清楚地；毫不隱瞞地

words.engDef: said or showed what you think or feel
words.example: The manager clearly expressed his concerns about the project's timeline.
words.chinese: 表達；闡述（想法、意見等）
words.rootPrefix: ex- (out) + press -> pressed out into words

words.engDef: to formally ask someone to attend something
words.example: The company will extend an invitation to all key stakeholders for the upcoming product launch event.
words.chinese: 發出邀請；正式邀請

words.engDef: to a very great degree
words.example: The market demand is extremely high this quarter, so we need to increase production.
words.chinese: 極其；非常，用於加強形容詞或副詞的程度，常見於商務報告或會議中強調程度。

words.engDef: with people meeting in person
words.example: Let's schedule a face-to-face meeting to discuss the project details.
words.chinese: 面對面地；直接地（指直接的會面或交流，而非透過電子郵件、電話等方式）

words.engDef: the front parts of people's heads; also confronts
words.example: The company's new marketing campaign aims to put a friendly face on its brand.
words.chinese: 面容；臉龐；（尤指）人物肖像
words.rootPrefix: facies (form, appearance, from facere to make)

words.engDef: very slightly; only just able to be heard or seen
words.example: I could faintly hear the speaker's voice over the noise of the crowd.
words.chinese: 微弱地；隱約地；幾乎聽不出來/看不見

words.engDef: the language of Iran
words.example: Our company is expanding into the Iranian market, and we need translators fluent in Farsi.
words.chinese: 波斯語，一種在伊朗、塔吉克斯坦及阿富汗等地使用的語言，在商務場合通常指伊朗語。

words.engDef: extremely interesting
words.example: The presentation on renewable energy was incredibly fascinating and kept the audience engaged.
words.chinese: 極具吸引力，令人著迷，能引起強烈興趣。

words.engDef: in a way that shows approval or gives an advantage
words.example: The board of directors viewed the merger proposal favorably.
words.chinese: 對...表示贊同或有利的；以積極的態度看待

words.engDef: to feel unwell, especially with an upset stomach
words.example: I'm sorry, I need to excuse myself; I'm feeling a bit sick.
words.chinese: 感到不適，身體不舒服，通常指噁心、頭暈或輕微的疾病。

words.engDef: the emotions someone has
words.example: The manager needs to be sensitive to the team's feelings during the restructuring process.
words.chinese: 情感；情緒，通常指個人對某事物的感受。

words.engDef: experiences an emotion or physical sensation
words.example: The manager feels that the new marketing strategy is effective.
words.chinese: 感覺；感到

words.engDef: pleased because someone has praised you
words.example: The manager was flattered by the employee's positive feedback on his leadership skills.
words.chinese: 因受到的讚美或稱讚而感到高興或自豪。

words.engDef: for a very short moment
words.example: The opportunity to invest in the startup appeared fleetingly, so we had to act quickly.
words.chinese: 短暫地、一閃而過地（指時間或機會非常短暫，僅出現瞬間）

words.engDef: able to speak a language easily and well
words.example: The candidate is fluent in both English and Mandarin, which is a significant advantage for this role.
words.chinese: 流利地掌握（一門語言），能自如地使用該語言進行溝通。

words.engDef: smoothly and without pausing, especially when speaking
words.example: The presenter delivered the speech fluently, captivating the audience.
words.chinese: 流暢地；以流利的語氣

words.engDef: to take further action about something already started
words.example: The sales manager will follow up on the potential client's request for a proposal.
words.chinese: 跟進處理；追蹤處理

words.engDef: instead of what usually happens
words.example: Let's try a different restaurant for a change.
words.chinese: 為了改變一下；為了新鮮感

words.engDef: for the benefit or purpose of
words.example: We delayed the project launch for the sake of ensuring quality.
words.chinese: 為了...的緣故；為了...的目的

words.engDef: people from another country
words.example: The company is expanding its services to cater to foreigners visiting the city.
words.chinese: 外國人；外國人士（通常指非本地居民）

words.engDef: the quality of following official rules and polite customs
words.example: The meeting requires a certain level of formality, so please dress professionally.
words.chinese: 正式程度；禮儀規範；莊重程度

words.engDef: presenting something in a particular way
words.example: The company's marketing team is framing the new product as a solution to environmental concerns.
words.chinese: 框構；塑造（觀點、敘述等）

words.engDef: honestly and directly, even if unwelcome
words.example: Frankly speaking, I don't think this project will be successful.
words.chinese: 坦率地；直率地（通常用於表達觀點或意見）

words.engDef: the language of France; relating to France
words.example: Our French-speaking sales representatives will attend the conference in Paris next month.
words.chinese: 法語；與法國相關的（形容詞）

words.engDef: to worry continuously about small things
words.example: Don't fret about the upcoming presentation; you've prepared well.
words.chinese: 擔憂；煩惱；焦慮；（使）磨損；侵蝕

words.engDef: disagreement between people; also resistance between surfaces
words.example: There was some friction between the two teams over resource allocation, which slowed down the project.
words.chinese: 摩擦；阻力；不和；衝突

words.engDef: kind and pleasant behaviour towards others
words.example: The hotel staff's friendliness made our stay a truly enjoyable experience.
words.chinese: 友善的態度或行為，尤其指讓人感到歡迎和舒適的特質。

words.engDef: to make someone afraid
words.example: The sudden power outage frightened the employees during the important presentation.
words.chinese: 使感到恐懼或害怕；驚嚇

words.engDef: a sudden outburst of public anger or excitement
words.example: The company faced a furor after the CEO's controversial remarks were leaked to the press.
words.chinese: 強烈爭議或公眾憤怒；風暴

words.engDef: to look steadily into something
words.example: During the presentation, the investors gazed into the CEO's eyes, assessing his confidence and vision.
words.chinese: 凝視、注視（通常帶有思考或期望），專注地看

words.engDef: the difference in attitudes between older and younger people
words.example: Bridging the generation gap is crucial for effective teamwork and knowledge transfer within the company.
words.chinese: 世代差異，指不同世代間在價值觀、生活方式、觀點等方面的差異，可能導致溝通障礙或衝突。

words.engDef: in a way that gives more than is expected
words.example: The company generously donated a large sum of money to the charity.
words.chinese: 慷慨地；大方地（指以樂於助人或提供資源的態度）

words.engDef: the different types of writing, music, or film
words.example: The marketing team needs to identify the target audience's preferred genres of music and movies.
words.chinese: 類型；類別（尤指文學、藝術、音樂等領域）

words.engDef: polite word for a group of men
words.example: The CEO addressed the gentlemen in the conference room with a brief update on the company's performance.
words.chinese: 先生們；紳士們（通常指一群男性，帶有尊重和禮貌的意味）

words.engDef: in a soft and careful way
words.example: Please handle the sensitive documents gently to avoid any damage.
words.chinese: 溫和地，輕柔地（指動作或語氣），避免造成冒犯或造成不適。

words.engDef: truly and sincerely
words.example: The CEO genuinely apologized for the company's error and promised improvements.
words.chinese: 真誠地；發自內心；誠實地

words.engDef: to receive a call on the telephone
words.example: I got a phone call from the supplier regarding the shipment delay.
words.chinese: 接聽電話；收到電話通知

words.engDef: to have a friendly relationship with someone
words.example: It's important to get along with your colleagues to maintain a positive work environment.
words.chinese: 與...和睦相處；相處融洽

words.engDef: to contact someone again later with an answer
words.example: I'll get back to you with the revised proposal by the end of the day.
words.chinese: 回覆；與...聯繫；再次取得聯繫

words.engDef: to join a queue; also to start following the rules
words.example: Please get in line at the security checkpoint before boarding the flight.
words.chinese: 排隊；遵守規定或程序

words.engDef: to make contact with someone
words.example: Please get in touch with our sales department if you have any questions about pricing.
words.chinese: 聯繫；與...取得聯繫

words.engDef: to recover from an illness or an unpleasant experience
words.example: After a brief illness, she was able to get over it and return to work.
words.chinese: 克服；恢復（從疾病、困難或情緒困擾中）

words.engDef: to understand the main idea being made
words.example: I think I'm starting to get the point of this new marketing strategy.
words.chinese: 理解；領會；明白重點

words.engDef: to succeed in reaching someone by phone; to survive a difficulty
words.example: I'm sorry, the line is busy. Please try again later to get through.
words.chinese: （電話中）接通、撥通；（困難情況中）度過、克服

words.engDef: to meet socially
words.example: Let's get together for coffee next week to discuss the project's progress.
words.chinese: 聚會；團聚（通常指非正式的社交聚會）

words.engDef: speaking quickly in a way that makes no sense
words.example: During the presentation, the nervous applicant was gibbering about his qualifications.
words.chinese: 喃喃自語；含糊不清地說話

words.engDef: to telephone someone
words.example: I'll give you a call later this afternoon to discuss the project details.
words.chinese: （電話）打電話；致電

words.engDef: to stop resisting and accept what others want
words.example: After lengthy negotiations, the company finally gave in to the union's demands.
words.chinese: 屈服；妥協；讓步（通常指在爭論或壓力下放棄自己的立場）

words.engDef: to make an attempt at something
words.example: Even though the project seems challenging, I'm willing to give it a try.
words.chinese: 嘗試一下；試試看，即使成功機率不高

words.engDef: willingly and with pleasure
words.example: I will gladly assist you with your presentation preparation.
words.chinese: 樂意地；很樂意地

words.engDef: to go and watch a film at the cinema
words.example: After a long week of meetings, the team decided to go to a film to relax.
words.chinese: 觀看電影（作為一種休閒娛樂活動，通常在工作時間外）

words.engDef: to match something, or to choose it
words.example: The new marketing strategy goes well with our company's values.
words.chinese: 搭配；配合；同意；同意從事某事

words.engDef: used to express surprise
words.example: Gosh, I completely forgot about our meeting!
words.chinese: 感嘆詞，用於表達驚訝、輕微的憤怒、困窘或強調，為「God」的委婉語。

words.engDef: talking about other people's private lives
words.example: The manager warned the team against gossiping about colleagues.
words.chinese: 八卦、閒聊（通常指不實或負面的傳言）

words.engDef: in a kind and polite way
words.example: The CEO graciously accepted the award on behalf of the company.
words.chinese: （尤指表示尊重或感激）友善地，慷慨地

words.engDef: pleased and satisfied
words.example: The manager was gratified to see the team exceeding their sales targets.
words.chinese: 感到滿意的；因得到滿足而欣喜的

words.engDef: welcomed someone with words or a gesture
words.example: The receptionist greeted all visitors with a warm smile and a polite introduction.
words.chinese: 迎接；問候（通常帶有禮貌或正式的語氣）

words.engDef: giving an answer without being sure it is right
words.example: We're just guessing at the project's completion date, as we haven't received the final report.
words.chinese: 憑直覺推測；基於假設的判斷

words.engDef: an informal word for a group of people
words.example: Hey guys, let's review the sales figures for Q3.
words.chinese: （非正式用语）伙计们，朋友们，同事们（通常指一群男性，也可泛指一群人）
words.rootPrefix: Guy Fawkes (the effigy burned in England every fifth of November)

words.engDef: used to say what someone should do to avoid trouble
words.example: You had better finish the report by Friday, or you'd miss the deadline.
words.chinese: 最好做…（表示建議或警告，強調做某事的重要性，若不採取行動可能會有負面後果）

words.engDef: to spend time relaxing with other people
words.example: Let's hang out after the conference to network and relax.
words.chinese: 閒逛、聚會、消磨時間（通常指輕鬆的社交活動）

words.engDef: the feeling of being pleased and content
words.example: The company aims to create a work environment that fosters employee happiness and productivity.
words.chinese: 幸福感；滿足感；快樂感，尤其指因工作或成就而產生的正面情緒。

words.engDef: to talk about a subject with other people
words.example: Let's have a discussion about the proposed budget cuts during the next team meeting.
words.chinese: 就某議題進行討論，通常涉及意見交換和探討。

words.engDef: the woman or girl already mentioned
words.example: She handled the project entirely by herself.
words.chinese: 她自己；她本人

words.engDef: slow to act or speak because you are unsure
words.example: The candidate was hesitant to answer the question about his previous salary.
words.chinese: 猶豫的；不確定的，帶有遲疑的
words.rootPrefix: haerere (to stick) + -itant -> stuck, unable to move on

words.engDef: used to attract attention or as an informal greeting
words.example: Hey, how are you doing today?
words.chinese: 嘿；喂 (用於引起注意、問候或表示驚訝、疑問、惱怒等)

words.engDef: an informal greeting
words.example: Hi, how are you today?
words.chinese: 嗨；你好

words.engDef: a sudden sound made in the throat; also a small problem
words.example: The speaker paused briefly, experiencing a hiccup during his presentation.
words.chinese: 短暫的呼吸中斷或抽搐，通常指因緊張或情緒波動引起的輕微呼吸暫停。

words.engDef: the most interesting or important parts
words.example: The presentation focused on the key highlights of the new product.
words.chinese: 重點、亮點（指特別值得注意或強調的部分，通常用於報告、簡報或產品描述中）

words.engDef: the man or boy already mentioned
words.example: He taught himself how to use the new software.
words.chinese: 自己（反身代名詞，強調主語和賓語是同一人或事物）

words.engDef: an imaginary small person from a novel
words.example: He's a bit of a hobbit, preferring quiet evenings at home to bustling business trips.
words.chinese: （指小說《魔戒》中的）霍比特人，通常指身材矮小、和平主義且喜歡舒適生活的虛構生物。在商業情境中，可用來比喻性格溫和、不喜歡冒險或衝突的員工。

words.engDef: nonsense; something completely untrue
words.example: I think his proposal is just a lot of hogwash and doesn't address the core issues.
words.chinese: 廢話；胡說八道；毫無根據的說詞

words.engDef: to stay on the phone and wait
words.example: I'm transferring you to the sales department. Please hold the line.
words.chinese: 請稍等，保持電話線路暢通，我會盡快回覆。

words.engDef: in a truthful way; used to stress that you mean it
words.example: To maintain a good working relationship, it's important to address concerns honestly.
words.chinese: 誠實地；坦率地；真誠地

words.engDef: it is hoped that; also in a hopeful way
words.example: Hopefully, the shipment will arrive before the deadline.
words.chinese: 表示希望或期望的語氣，通常用於表達對未來事件的樂觀預期。

words.engDef: wishes for something to happen
words.example: The company hopes to secure a major contract with the overseas client.
words.chinese: 期望；期盼（尤指基於可能性的期望）

words.engDef: wanting something to happen and thinking it might
words.example: We are hoping for a positive response from the potential investor.
words.chinese: 期望、盼望（某事發生或實現）

words.engDef: used to show that you did not hear or understand
words.example: Huh? What did you just say? I didn't catch that.
words.chinese: 表示疑問、驚訝、不理解或不贊同的語氣詞；或用於引起對方注意、徵求同意。

words.engDef: causing pain to someone or something
words.example: The company is hurting financially due to the recent economic downturn.
words.chinese: 造成疼痛；使人感到不舒服（通常指身體或情感上的疼痛）

words.engDef: saying one thing while doing another
words.example: The manager's hypocritical advice about teamwork, while he consistently worked alone, was met with skepticism.
words.chinese: 虛偽的；言行不一的，不誠實的

words.engDef: used to say you do not know at all
words.example: I'm sorry, I have no idea how to resolve this technical issue.
words.chinese: 完全不知道；毫無頭緒；不清楚

words.engDef: if you have no objection
words.example: If it’s okay with you, I’d like to schedule a meeting for next Tuesday.
words.chinese: 如果對您沒有不便的話；如果您覺得可以的話

words.engDef: if what I remember is correct
words.example: If I’m not mistaken, the deadline for the project is next Friday.
words.chinese: 如果我沒記錯的話；如果我沒有搞錯的話（用於表達對先前說明的確認或修正，帶有一定程度的謙虛或不確定性）

words.engDef: if it can be done
words.example: If possible, please send the report to my email address by Friday.
words.chinese: 如果可以的話；盡可能地

words.engDef: said when you agree because the other person is firm
words.example: If you insist on using that outdated software, we can't guarantee compatibility.
words.chinese: 如果您堅持如此，那就這樣吧。

words.engDef: paid no attention to
words.example: The email was ignored due to a high volume of incoming messages.
words.chinese: 被忽略；未被注意

words.engDef: to explain something by giving examples or pictures
words.example: The report uses charts and graphs to illustrate the company's financial performance.
words.chinese: 闡明；說明；以圖例說明

words.engDef: to copy the way someone else does something
words.example: The new employee was asked to imitate the successful sales techniques of the senior staff.
words.chinese: 模仿；效仿（通常指行為、風格或聲音）

words.engDef: unwilling to wait calmly
words.example: She became impatient with the slow service at the restaurant.
words.chinese: 不耐煩的；沒耐心的；急躁的

words.engDef: suggested without saying directly
words.example: The contract includes an implied guarantee of timely delivery.
words.chinese: 暗示的；含蓄的；未明言但可推斷的

words.engDef: suggesting something without saying it directly
words.example: The manager's comments were implying dissatisfaction with the project's progress.
words.chinese: 暗示、間接表示（某種意思或含義），通常帶有隱含的意義。

words.engDef: feeling admiration for something good
words.example: The client was deeply impressed by our company's commitment to sustainability.
words.chinese: 留下深刻印象；使感到滿意或欽佩

words.engDef: in a way that causes admiration
words.example: The presentation was delivered impressively, capturing the audience's attention from the start.
words.chinese: 令人印象深刻地；以令人驚豔的方式

words.engDef: very soon
words.example: I'll send you the report in a moment.
words.chinese: 片刻、馬上，稍等一下（表示很快就會做某事）

words.engDef: in a hopeful and constructive way
words.example: The manager instructed the team to address the customer's complaint in a positive manner.
words.chinese: 以積極的方式；以正面的態度

words.engDef: as a way of showing thanks for something
words.example: We are holding this event in appreciation of our loyal customers.
words.chinese: 為了表達對...的感激之情；因對...心懷感激

words.engDef: shared by two or more people
words.example: Our companies have a lot in common regarding sustainability practices.
words.chinese: 在共同點上；有共同之處；有相似之處

words.engDef: used to introduce the final part of what you are saying
words.example: In conclusion, the project was a success due to the team's hard work and dedication.
words.chinese: 總結；結論上

words.engDef: when compared with something very different
words.example: While the initial projections showed a loss, in contrast, the revised forecast indicates a significant profit.
words.chinese: 相反地；與之相反

words.engDef: fortunate in getting what you want
words.example: We were in luck to secure the contract with such a short deadline.
words.chinese: 幸運的；運氣好的

words.engDef: by meeting someone rather than phoning or writing
words.example: The CEO prefers to discuss sensitive matters in person with the board members.
words.chinese: 親自、當面

words.engDef: where other people cannot hear or see
words.example: Let's discuss this matter in private to avoid any misunderstandings.
words.chinese: 私下地；不公開地

words.engDef: said in as few words as possible
words.example: In short, the project is behind schedule and requires immediate attention.
words.chinese: 簡而言之；總之；簡而言道

words.engDef: giving only the main points
words.example: In summary, the project is on schedule and within budget.
words.chinese: 總結來說；簡而言之

words.engDef: one after another in order; also as a result
words.example: Each team member will present their findings in turn during the meeting.
words.chinese: 輪流；接著；按順序

words.engDef: in a written form rather than spoken
words.example: Please submit your application in writing by Friday.
words.chinese: 以書面形式；書面地

words.engDef: not suitable for the occasion
words.example: His comments were highly inappropriate for a professional meeting.
words.chinese: 不適當的；不妥的；不合時宜的

words.engDef: showing or pointing something out
words.example: The rising sales figures indicate a successful marketing campaign.
words.chinese: 指示；表明；顯示
words.rootPrefix: in- (toward) + dic (to point out, to say)

words.engDef: not going straight to the point or the place
words.example: The company prefers direct communication, but sometimes an indirect approach is necessary.
words.chinese: 間接的；不直接的；不坦率的；迂迴的
words.rootPrefix: in- (not) + di- (apart) + rect (to make straight, from regere)

words.engDef: not in a direct way
words.example: She indirectly suggested that he should apply for the promotion.
words.chinese: 間接地，婉轉地；不直接地
words.rootPrefix: in- (not) + di- (apart) + rect (to make straight, from regere) + -ly

words.engDef: relaxed and not following official rules

words.engDef: the things someone plans to do

words.engDef: the abilities that help you work well with other people

words.chinese: 人際互動技巧，指在工作環境中有效溝通、合作和建立關係的能力。

words.engDef: to explain the meaning of something

words.engDef: made someone known to another person, or brought in something new

words.engDef: making people known to each other, or bringing in something new

words.engDef: together with another person or group

words.engDef: kind and caring towards other people

words.chinese: 聆聽；傾聽；收聽（資訊、聲音等）

words.chinese: 外觀；看起來的樣子；審查；檢查

words.chinese: 沉浸於...之中；全神貫注於...，忘卻時間和周圍環境

words.chinese: 失去理智、發脾氣，尤其是在壓力或挫折的情況下。

words.engDef: unable to find your way; also no longer possessed

words.chinese: 迷失；遺失；找不到

words.chinese: 女士；夫人（用於正式場合或對不認識的女性的尊稱）

words.chinese: 撥打電話；致電

words.chinese: 發表演講；進行演說

words.chinese: 給人留下深刻印象；使人印象深刻

words.chinese: 使明確；闡明；說明清楚

words.chinese: 感到自在、隨意，把自己當作自己家一樣

words.chinese: 調解

words.engDef: the things you remember from the past

words.engDef: sending short written messages electronically

words.engDef: used to say that something is possible

words.chinese: 可能；或許；可以（表示可能性或許可）；力量；能力

words.example: He's a detail-minded employee who always ensures accuracy in his reports.

words.engDef: not correctly understood

words.engDef: in a way that does not boast; also to a small degree

words.chinese: 謙虛地；適度地；以不引人注目的方式

words.chinese: 母親；媽媽（指親生或養育的母親）

words.example: Excuse me, could you move over one seat to make room for the passenger with the wheelchair?
words.chinese: 讓出座位，讓出一個座位給某人。

words.engDef: in a way that was very unexpected

words.chinese: 出乎意料地；令人驚訝地

words.engDef: the person speaking
words.example: I'll handle this project myself to ensure it's completed on time.
words.chinese: 我自己；本人

words.engDef: strange and difficult to explain

words.chinese: 難以解釋的；神秘的，引人好奇的，通常與不確定或未知的狀況相關。

words.chinese: 合十禮；印度教、佛教、耆那教等中，表示問候、尊敬的用語

words.chinese: 可協商的；可談判的；可轉讓的

words.example: She is a skilled negotiator who always manages to secure favorable deals.
words.chinese: 談判者；協商者

words.engDef: people who live or work next to you

words.engDef: not one and not the other of two

words.engDef: meeting people who may be useful to you in your work

words.engDef: the state of not supporting either side

words.chinese: 中立立場；不偏袒的態度或政策

words.engDef: in a pleasant or satisfactory way

words.chinese: 友善地、禮貌地、得體地

words.engDef: used as a polite reply to thanks; not in the least

words.chinese: 一點也不；完全沒有；表示否定或禮貌的回應，表示不客氣或無需感謝。

words.engDef: used to say you do not think so, as far as you know

words.chinese: 據我所知，沒有。

words.engDef: used to add something further that is also important
words.example: The project is already behind schedule, not to mention the budget overruns.
words.chinese: 更不用說；更別提；遑論

words.chinese: 通知；告知

words.engDef: used to say the exact hour of the day

words.chinese: 點鐘

words.engDef: in a way that is easy to see or understand

words.chinese: 顯而易見地；毫無疑問地

words.engDef: particular times when events happen; special events

words.chinese: 特殊場合；重要時刻

words.engDef: to say sorry to someone

words.chinese: 向…道歉；為…提出道歉

words.engDef: acceptable; used to show agreement

words.engDef: acting for or representing someone else

words.chinese: 代表；以...的名義

words.engDef: waiting on the phone; also delayed for now

words.chinese: 暫停處理；待命

words.engDef: immediately and where you are; without preparation

words.engDef: used to refer to particular people or things already mentioned

words.chinese: 指代先前提及的特定人或物，表示『那些』或『這些』的意思。

words.engDef: moving to a position on top of something

words.engDef: used to express surprise or pleasure

words.engDef: without hiding anything

words.engDef: the views someone holds about something

words.chinese: 意見；看法；觀點（通常指基於個人經驗或知識的看法）

words.engDef: on the other side of an argument or contest

words.chinese: 對立的；相反的；抗拒的

words.engDef: the remaining people or things

words.engDef: sad or not satisfied
words.example: The team was unhappy with the project's delayed launch.
words.chinese: 不快樂的；不滿意的；沮喪的

words.engDef: impossible to understand
words.example: His handwriting was almost unintelligible, so I couldn't read the note.
words.chinese: 難以理解的；含糊不清的；費解的；無法聽懂或辨認的

words.engDef: different from; not typical of
words.example: Unlike our competitor, we offer 24/7 customer support.
words.chinese: 與...不同；與...不一樣

words.engDef: not enjoyable or agreeable
words.example: The meeting was unpleasant due to the heated argument between the two managers.
words.chinese: 令人不快的；不愉快的；不舒服的

words.engDef: not fair or sensible; asking too much
words.example: The company found the supplier's pricing demands unreasonable.
words.chinese: 不合理；不合邏輯；過於嚴苛

words.engDef: not certain about something
words.example: I'm unsure whether we should proceed with the project without further market research.
words.chinese: 不確定的；猶豫的；對...感到懷疑
words.rootPrefix: un- (not) + securus (free from care: se- without + cura care)

words.engDef: not wanting to do something
words.example: The company was unwilling to invest more resources into the failing project.
words.chinese: 不願意的；不情願的

words.engDef: cheerful and full of hope
words.example: The team leader delivered an upbeat presentation, boosting employee morale.
words.chinese: 積極、樂觀的；充滿活力的

words.engDef: something that is said
words.example: Her every utterance was carefully considered.
words.chinese: 發言; 說話; 言詞; 表達

words.engDef: completely; absolutely
words.example: The project failed utterly due to poor planning and communication.
words.chinese: 完全地；徹底地（強調程度，通常帶有負面或驚訝的語氣）

words.engDef: the feelings or atmosphere given off by a person or place
words.example: The conference room had a positive vibe, encouraging open discussion.
words.chinese: 氛圍；氣氛；感受（通常指一種非語言的情緒或感覺）

words.engDef: opinions; also what you can see from a place
words.example: The marketing team needs to analyze customer views on the new product.
words.chinese: 觀點；看法；意見；瀏覽次數
words.rootPrefix: vid (to see, from videre) -> what is seen

words.engDef: going to see a person or place
words.example: The sales team is visiting potential clients next week to present our new product.
words.chinese: 拜訪；參觀（通常指商務或正式場合的拜訪）
words.rootPrefix: visitare (to go to see, from videre to see)

words.engDef: said openly; also spoken with the voice
words.example: The voiced consonants, like 'b' and 'd', vibrate the vocal cords.
words.chinese: （聲音）有聲的；發聲的

words.engDef: a system that records spoken messages from callers
words.example: I'm sorry I missed your call. Please leave a voicemail and I'll get back to you as soon as possible.
words.chinese: 語音留言信箱；語音留言服務

words.engDef: to stand in a queue until it is your turn
words.example: Customers are asked to wait in line to speak with a representative.
words.chinese: 排隊等候；在隊伍中等待

words.engDef: told someone about a possible danger or problem
words.example: The security guard warned us about the potential for pickpockets in the crowded market.
words.chinese: 警告；提醒（通常指潛在的危險或問題）

words.engDef: careful and slightly suspicious of something
words.example: The company is wary of investing in new technologies without thorough market research.
words.chinese: 對...持謹慎態度；對...感到警戒

words.engDef: to view a film from beginning to end
words.example: After a long day of meetings, I like to watch a film to relax.
words.chinese: 觀看電影；欣賞電影（通常指休閒娛樂或放鬆活動）

words.engDef: any one of a set that you choose
words.example: You can choose whichever seat you prefer.
words.chinese: 無論哪個；任何一個

words.engDef: used to express surprise or to tell someone to slow down
words.example: Whoa! That's a significant increase in sales figures.
words.chinese: 驚嘆詞，表示驚訝、震驚或讚賞，通常伴隨停頓。

words.engDef: to move from side to side in small quick movements
words.example: The child wiggled with excitement when he saw the ice cream.
words.chinese: 扭動；擺動；蠕動；（俚語）迴旋餘地

words.engDef: most extreme or least likely
words.example: The marketing team proposed the wildest ideas to attract new customers, but the CEO preferred a more conservative approach.
words.chinese: 最瘋狂的；最極端的；最不可能的（指想法、計畫或情況）

words.engDef: the state of being ready and happy to do something
words.example: We appreciate your willingness to work extra hours on this project.
words.chinese: 願意；樂意；情願

words.engDef: desires for something to happen; also good greetings
words.example: The company wishes its employees a happy and prosperous New Year.
words.chinese: 願望；期望（通常指無法實現或不太可能實現的願望）

words.engDef: the ability to say clever and amusing things
words.example: The negotiator's quick wit helped diffuse the tense situation.
words.chinese: 機智；幽默的智慧，通常用於巧妙地表達或回應。

words.engDef: certainly; with no uncertainty at all
words.example: The project was completed ahead of schedule, without a doubt a success.
words.chinese: 毫無疑問地；絕對地；肯定地

words.engDef: thinking about something you would like to know
words.example: I'm wondering if the new marketing strategy will increase sales.
words.chinese: 感到好奇、想知道（某事）；思考、考慮

words.engDef: anxious about something that might happen
words.example: The project manager is worried about the delay in delivering the final report.
words.chinese: 擔憂；焦慮，對某事感到不安

words.engDef: used for polite requests or to describe past habits
words.example: I would like to book a table for two this evening.
words.chinese: （will 的過去式）將會；願意；想要；慣於；表示委婉的請求、建議、假定或條件

words.engDef: used to express great surprise or admiration
words.example: Wow, that's an amazing view from the top of the mountain!
words.chinese: 感嘆詞：表示驚訝、高興、讚嘆。動詞：使人驚嘆、留下深刻印象。名詞：令人驚嘆的事物或感覺。

words.engDef: strongly disliking people from other countries
words.example: The company strives to create an inclusive work environment, free from xenophobic attitudes.
words.chinese: 對外族人或不同文化抱持恐懼、厭惡或偏見的態度。

words.engDef: shouting loudly
words.example: The manager was yelling at the employee for missing the deadline.
words.chinese: 大聲喊叫，咆哮（通常帶有憤怒或不滿的情緒）

words.engDef: an informal way of saying yes
words.example: Are you ready to go?
words.chinese: 是的；對；沒錯（非正式）

words.engDef: the person being spoken to
words.example: Please review the document yourself before submitting it to your supervisor.
words.chinese: 指代自己；親自
